input.content: Pattern: flipping a config default (e.g. DETAILED_REPORT False→True) promotes a previously opt-in code path to the default path, exposing latent defects that were only reachable via explicit opt-in. Tests updated to the new default typically cover only the happy populated case, not boundaries (empty input). Example: batch report detailed mode computed mean as sum/len with no empty guard; enabling it by default turned report([]) from "Items: 0" into ZeroDivisionError. Review check: when a default flips, re-run the boundary cases (empty, zero, None) through the newly-default path, and test the default path itself, not only explicit overrides.
